name: Indiana University South Bend
tuition_note: In-state (resident) undergraduate tuition & mandatory fees 2025-26 = $8,424, confirmed by Indiana Commission for Higher Education 'Resident Undergraduate Tuition and Mandatory Fees 2025-27 Biennium ENACTED' PDF (in.gov/che, dated June 24, 2025; South Bend line held flat from 2024-25). Public school, resident rate used. Housing (room only) from southbend.iu.edu River Crossing Campus Housing rates page (2026 academic year): $7,160/yr for 4-bedroom unit (lowest room-only rate); other room-only options range up to $10,454/yr for a 1-bedroom single. Website: southbend.iu.edu.
